developments.title: Serbia receives first two Rafale fighters

indicators_to_watch: Delivery of the next two aircraft before year end.

sentences.text: 3 of 10 material air-power developments this period are of HIGH relevance to Hungary.
Hungary accepts first KC-390 transport — begins replacing Hungary's tactical airlift capacity; IOC depends on crew training.
Serbia's first Rafale deliveries indicate the start of a Western fighter capability on Hungary's southern border, with meaningful scale 1-3 years away.
USAF rotates F-35A squadron to Łask, Poland, for eastern flank air policing — temporarily adds fifth-generation fighters to Allied QRA capacity in Poland.
In Hungary's immediate and near region, material change was assessed for Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Ukraine; no material change was identified for Russia, Austria, Slovakia, Czechia.
Collection gaps remain for Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia, Bulgaria: absence of reporting there is not evidence of inactivity.
No reported event moved a programme-of-record quantity this period.
